description: The URL where this app's UNPUBLISHED changes can be looked at, and a link that opens it (the plain hostname refuses without one). Call this after EVERY change to an app that publishes on request, and give the user the link with a plain sentence: their change is on the preview, their real site is untouched, and it goes live when they say so. Without that sentence they look at their own website, see nothing, and conclude the change was lost.
name: runzero_work_url
title: Get preview link
